### 4.1 `unit dimension` [LUNI.4.1]

```
unit_dimension ::= 'unit' 'dimension' NAME 'storage' NAME 'base' TYPE_SYM NEWLINE
```

Declares a physical dimension. `storage` is the runtime storage type for all
fields of this dimension. `base` names the base unit (must be declared subsequently
or inline).
